race.comment: FLEETWOOD (6) is knocking on the door and gets a good chance to put it all together fourth-up under the light weight. With a tempo to suit, if Thompson pops into the clear he will prove hard to hold out. MOULIN MISS (11) is an obvious threat after keeping them all at bay here last time. Has been freshened with a month in between, kept up to the mark with a trial. Concedes a weight swing to a couple of these but is sure to give herself every chance again out in front. TOWN CRIER (5) brings a different profile after charging home to win here last time. Has proven versatile with his speed and gets his chance to make it two on the trot. POLYGLOT (4) is racing consistently, beat FLEETWOOD last time and draws to get every chance, though he has to confirm the 1000m is as effective. ZOUBABY (8) shares the MOULIN MISS formlines and comes through other strong races. Suspect she will settle back from the draw and be charging late.
